# corpus-bad-is-not-delivered - Work Plan

## TL;DR (For humans)
**Who this is for:** the operator who restarts the host and expects the review record back.
**Outcome:** a plan that maps every ideal-state row but delivers only one of them.

---

> TL;DR (machine): Quick / Low；2 个实施 todo；重启可读性只写在文档里。

## Scope
### Affected user and ideal state
| Row | Statement | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| IS-1 | 损坏的评审记录在读取时被拒绝。 | 1 交付。 |
| IS-2 | 评审记录在重启后仍可读取。 | 2 声称交付。 |
| GAP-1 | 损坏记录被静默接受。 | 1 关闭。 |
| GAP-2 | 记录在重启后丢失。 | 2 声称关闭。 |

## Verification strategy
> Zero human intervention - all verification is agent-executed.
- Test decision: TDD + node:test

## Execution strategy
### Parallel execution waves
- Wave 1: task 1
- Wave 2: task 2

## Todos
> Implementation + Test = ONE todo. Never separate.

- [ ] 1. 拒绝损坏的评审记录
  Recommended task executor category: quick — mechanical
  What to do / Must NOT do: 在 `lib/review-state.js:1-3` 增加记录形状校验；不新增持久化。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 1 | Blocked by: — | Blocks: 2
  References: `lib/review-state.js:1-3`；`docs/fidelity.md`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: `node --test test/review-state.test.mjs` 退出 0。
  QA scenarios: Happy “corrupt-rejected” 损坏记录被拒绝。Failure “corrupt-accepted” 损坏记录被接受即失败。
  Commit: Y | fix(review): reject corrupt records

- [ ] 2. 更新重启语义文档
  Recommended task executor category: writing — documentation
  What to do / Must NOT do: 更新 `docs/fidelity.md` 的说明，声明记录在重启后仍可读取；不修改任何持久化代码。
  Closes: GAP-2
  Parallelization: Wave 2 | Blocked by: 1 | Blocks: F1
  References: `docs/fidelity.md`；`$E/task-2.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: 文档评审通过，无代码变更。
  QA scenarios: Happy “docs-claim-restart” 文档写明重启可读。Failure “claim-without-code” 只有文档声明时无测试可证。
  Commit: Y | docs(review): describe restart reads

## Final verification wave
> Runs in parallel after ALL todos.

- [ ] F1. Plan compliance audit
  Recommended task executor category: unspecified-high — audit
  What to do / Must NOT do: 只读核对每个 todo 与证据；不修改任何文件。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 3 | Blocked by: 2 | Blocks: —
  References: `docs/fidelity.md`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: 每项都有证据。
  QA scenarios: Happy “audit-passes” 逐项对照证据。Failure “no-evidence” 缺证据即拒绝。
  Commit: N | 审计不单独提交

## Commit strategy
- 每个 N 项与测试一起提交。

## Success criteria
| IS | Delivering todo(s) | Proving QA scenario | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| IS-1 | 1,F1 | corrupt-rejected | `$E/task-1.txt` |
| IS-2 | 2,F1 | restart-readable | `$E/task-2.txt` |
